notes: 10-Q for the quarter ended July 1, 2018. The index (lines 31 to 48) is not labeled. Part I Item 3 describes the effect of a refinancing on market risk and is not marked. Part II Item 1 gives its own litigation statement and is not marked; Part II Item 1A only points to the risk factors in the 2017 Form 10-K and says there are no material changes, so it is marked incorporated, as in the fresh2 Terex and American Woodmark labels. Part II has no Items 3, 4 or 5, which are listed absent. Uncertain: 'PART II. OTHER INFORMATION' is followed by an unnumbered 'Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements and Projections' (lines 1166 to 1200, about 8,000 characters) before Part II Item 1. As text under a Part heading before its first Item, like a forward-looking section between 'PART I' and Item 1 of a 10-K, it belongs to no Item, so Part I Item 4 ends at the PART II line. The alternative leaves the section in Part I Item 4 under the plain next-heading rule. Both labelers chose the same end. Item 6 holds the exhibit list; the filing ends at SIGNATURES.
